card.name: Radiation dosimetry and partner treatment
card.fires_on: Words inside radiation dosimetry sections, such as 'absorbed radiation doses to' and 'dosimetry', in imaging drug labels. Also 'treated' or 'treatment' after sexual partners.

modes.label: Radiation dose wording
modes.description: Words in phrases like 'estimated absorbed radiation doses to an average patient' in dosimetry sections.
modes.example: The estimated absorbed radiation doses<< to>> an average patient (70 kg)

modes.label: Sex partner treatment
modes.description: The word treated or treatment when describing sexual partners getting care for an infection.
modes.example: It's not usually necessary for your sex partner to be<< treated>>.

card.plain: It lights up in radiation dose tables of imaging drug labels, and a little in text about treating sexual partners.
